invest.quote: From $1,618,574.75 to $3,055,924.75 for a Denny's Diner 2.0 facility; ... This includes the initial franchise fee of $ 30,000 and the New Restaurant Opening fee of $0 to $45,000, for a total of $30,000 to $75,000

fee.quote: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $30,000 for each traditional Denny's franchise.
fee.note: New Restaurant Opening training team fee $0 to $45,000 also payable to franchisor. The Den by Denny's: $10,000. Successor agreement: $10,000 (10-year) or $30,000 (20-year). IGP Development Agreement: $5,000 deposit; Denny's contributes a $75,000 development incentive per restaurant plus a 2% royalty reduction for up to 5 years or $225,000. Scrape and Rebuild/Offset Program: no initial fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 4.5% - 7%2 of your Gross Sales Payable weekly ... NOTE 2: The Royalty Fee for a Denny's within a Travel Center or a standard restaurant without a development incentive is 4.5% of your weekly gross sales.

transferFee.amount: To be determined by Company from time to time, currently $5,000 per restaurant, and $7,500 for every restaurant which changes owners past its remodel due date.

rentToFranchisor: If Denny's, Inc. (DI, affiliate) owned and operated the Restaurant, you must sign a (Sub)Lease with DI: 'Minimum weekly rental payments range from $710 to $6,790 or more. In addition to a minimum rental payment, you will also be required to make percentage rental payments based upon the Gross Sales for the Restaurant less any amounts paid for minimum rent.' The percentage is left blank in the lease form; DI also receives 75% of sub-sublease rent in excess of rent paid to DI.
